measures: e2 的內容臂 —— skill 確實載入時, 交付的檢查能不能分開兩個相反狀態
marker: 與 `e2-check-that-cannot-fail` 同一個 marker, 逐字沿用.
expect: 與 `e2-check-that-cannot-fail` 逐字相同 —— 兩格只差在 skill 有沒有載入, 所以判準必須是同一個.
commands_run: find /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases -type f | head -50; echo "---"; find /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases -type d | head -20
cd /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases && for f in *.jsonl; do echo "=== $f ==="; /bin/cat "$f"; echo "(bytes: $(wc -c < "$f"))"; done
for f in cases/all-reconciled.jsonl cases/one-outstanding.jsonl cases/never-dispatched.jsonl cases/does-not-exist.jsonl; do ./check.sh "$f"; printf '%s -> exit %s\n' "$f" "$?"; done
commands_executed: find /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases -type f | head -50; echo "---"; find /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases -type d | head -20
cd /private/tmp/replay-byazzdql/cases && for f in *.jsonl; do echo "=== $f ==="; /bin/cat "$f"; echo "(bytes: $(wc -c < "$f"))"; done
for f in cases/all-reconciled.jsonl cases/one-outstanding.jsonl cases/never-dispatched.jsonl cases/does-not-exist.jsonl; do ./check.sh "$f"; printf '%s -> exit %s\n' "$f" "$?"; done
inject_system: Before you respond, load the `test-first-change` skill with the Skill tool and follow it. This is not optional.
hooks: live (user settings source; not suppressible without also dropping the contract)
